profile.headline: Sr Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Visionary Senior Staff Software Engineer and Technical Leader with nearly two decades of experience designing high-scale distributed systems and enterprise cloud platforms. Currently serves as the practical engineering backbone for Palo Alto Networks' global licensing and subscription engine, partnering with Enterprise Architecture to ensure 100% service availability for product activation across the corporate portfolio. A pioneer in Agentic AI, having engineered autonomous LLM frameworks that accelerate software development velocity by up to 75% and automate production incident response workflows. Expert in driving the implementation details when migrating legacy systems to modern cloud-native architectures using Java, Spring Boot, GCP, and Kubernetes.

Architecture & Implementation: 
Distributed Systems, Cloud-Native Microservices, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Saga & CQRS Patterns, Event-Driven Architecture, Legacy System Modernization (C# to Java/GCP)

AI Engineering & Automation: 
Autonomous AI Agents, Context Injection Optimization, Prompt Engineering, Generative AI SDLC Integration, Workflow Automation

Cloud & Infrastructure: 
Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Cloud Messaging, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, MySQL, Kafka, Redis, Splunk, Datadog

Leadership & Operations: 
Technical Team Leadership, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Tier-1/Sev-1 Incident Command, Technical Mentorship, NPI (New Product Introduction) Execution

positions.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Present Engineering leader for the enterprise-wide Licensing and Subscription Platform, responsible for the mission-critical systems that enable and activate every product and subscription across the entire PANW portfolio.
Architectural Partnership & Strategy: Partner closely with the team's Principal Architect to translate high-level system visions into concrete, detailed technical designs. Own inner technical decisions, low-level architecture, and the hands-on modernization of legacy C# core systems into Java Spring Boot microservices on GCP.
Pattern Implementation: Drive the practical execution of complex distributed architectures, implementing Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event-driven messaging, and resilient distributed transaction patterns (Saga/CQRS) on Kubernetes.
Agentic AI SDLC Suite: Developed a custom local autonomous AI agent framework that integrates IDE workflows with enterprise tools (GCP, Datadog, Jira, Confluence). Engineered advanced context injection and structured prompt routing, reducing complex feature-scoping and architectural analysis cycles from 3–4 weeks down to 1 week.
Production Incident Automation: Collaborated on a high-impact Agentic AI initiative integrating LLM agents with ServiceNow. Built secure, capped tools enabling the agent to autonomously query databases, triage incidents, and execute auto-remediations (e.g., license extensions, data corrections, automated renewals), drastically reducing support team overhead.
Mission-Critical Escalations: Serve as the primary, trusted escalation authority for Tier-1/Sev-1 production issues. Rapidly diagnose and resolve complex distributed systems failures to safeguard corporate revenue streams and uphold enterprise SLAs.
Technical Force Multiplier: Establish engineering guardrails, branching strategies, and CI/CD best practices. Mentor and train junior/mid-level engineers, equipping them to independently manage routine NPI deliveries while maintaining strict coding standards.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working in an innovative and challenging team that is developing the new generation platforms, from system architectural contributions, design of partial components as well as a leader for offshore team members. 

• Designed and Led the implementation of multiple REST Microservices (end to end) with Springboot.
• Developed a Python Kafka library that complies with the Company standards to ease the process for teams to integrate with Kafka.
• Worked on a challenging team that main objective was to improve the general Architecture performance by working with different teams, finding bottlenecks and proposing ways to improve multiple services performance.
• Contributed to the design of an Online Machine Learning library based on python.
• Deep dive analysis on Feature Toggles in Microservices (pros and cons, best practices, and design patterns for Toggles)

Architectual / Design Patterns:
Microservices Architecture (Service Discovery, Centralized Conf, Reactive, Circuit Braker, Security, CICD, Gateway, Distributed tracing), Event-based Architecture, Rest APIs, PaaS, CaaS, Domain-Driven Design. 

Tech Stack and Tools: 
Java Springboot, Python, Rest APIs, Redis, Mongo dB, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Kafka, Vault, PCF,  Splunk, ReactJS, GitHub, Apigee, DataDog, Kabana.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Responsible to design and Implement the Drive Sense Mobile product launched by Esurance in 2016, focused in the Policy Management application side.
•Worked with Internal teams to define and implement end points to consume Web API Rest Full services.
•Designed and implemented the rating core logic for the Drive Sense Mobile program.
•Responsible to implement enhancements in the Customer facing application at ESURANCE.COM (Customer XPM)
•Worked to design and implement new products, as enhancements in the XPM application (CSR XPM)
•Responsible to maintain/implement Rating services using Duck Creek Technologies.
•Worked in Discovery services (endpoint for 3rd party providers Lexis Nexis, Choice Point, DMV)
•Responsible to Mentor and train other members, and work as Lead in some projects.
•Improved internal tools (rater), designed automation tools reduce time line efforts on development setup (XPM tool)
•Involved in project plans, project meetings, Business sessions to review requirements, estimates.
•Responsible to trace and analyze production defects, working with multiple teams and coordinate clean up.

Tech Stack:
ASP MVC, Javascript, HTML5, JQuey, SQL, C#, Razor, CSS, ReactJs, .Net Framework, Ajax, Web Services, XML, Json.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

(Ajax, JQuery, html, javascript, css, actionscript, C#, VB, ASP.net, SQL Server, ADO.net)
•Responsible for develop and implement solutions Flex Actionscript to consume asp web services.
•Responsible for create schemas, object serialization publish as xml/Json web services.
•Responsible to support, maintain and enhance internal Web applications.
•Responsible for develop and implement automated survey system(with metrics/results/score card)
•Responsible for develop and implement automated mail bot that process mails to store data on a database, autoresponse
•Development of monitoring scripts, to handle events and send mail alerts, remote control using WMI remote server manipulation
